name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessibility upgrade?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for an accessibility upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves several key steps. Look for contractors with specific experience in accessibility modifications, a strong portfolio of completed projects, and positive client testimonials. Ensure they are licensed and insured in California. Inquire about their process for understanding your specific needs, their approach to design, and how they handle project management and communication. A contractor who prioritizes client collaboration and offers clear, detailed proposals is ideal.
